title: The Old Woman with the Candle
summary: Every stormy night, an elderly widow placed a single tallow candle in her attic window overlooking the dangerous coastal reef....
full_text:
Every stormy night, an elderly widow placed a single tallow candle in her attic window overlooking the dangerous coastal reef.

Wealthy townspeople laughed at her meager flicker, but that solitary light guided dozens of fishing boats safely through the roaring breakers and saved hundreds of lives from shipwreck.

Before the eyes of heaven, her humble candle shone brighter than the chandeliers of kings.
moral: A small candle of kindness placed in the window guides lost travelers safely through the dark.
